title.original: OSGym: Scalable OS Infra for Computer Use Agents
title.zh: OSGym：面向计算机使用代理的可扩展OS Infra
title.en: OSGym: Scalable OS Infra for Computer Use Agents

inclusion_reason.zh: OSGym 的 VM 编排、写时复制存储和分层恢复构成可复用的千副本级计算机 Agent 沙箱运行基础设施。
inclusion_reason.en: OSGym's VM orchestration, copy-on-write storage, and layered recovery form reusable thousand-replica sandbox infrastructure for computer agents.

abstract.zh: OSGym 是面向计算机使用 Agent 的大规模操作系统沙箱基础设施，通过虚拟化、去中心化状态和故障恢复降低并行轨迹采集成本。
abstract.en: OSGym is large-scale operating-system sandbox infrastructure for computer-use agents, reducing parallel trajectory-collection cost through virtualization, decentralized state, and fault recovery.

problem.zh: 完整 GUI 操作系统副本消耗大量 CPU、内存和磁盘，软件随机故障又会在规模化训练时放大并拖垮中心化管理。
problem.en: Full GUI OS replicas consume substantial CPU, memory, and disk, while stochastic software failures amplify at training scale and overwhelm centralized management.

approach.zh: 系统采用副本级去中心化状态、硬件感知编排、KVM 与写时复制磁盘，并以多层容器池恢复隔离和替换故障实例。
approach.en: The design combines replica-local state, hardware-aware orchestration, KVM with copy-on-write disks, and a multilayer container pool that isolates and replaces failed instances.

system_design.zh: 控制面进行资源感知放置，数据面运行共享基础盘的 VM 副本；本地状态管理器和分层恢复器负责故障边界、重试与池补充。
system_design.en: A resource-aware control plane places VM replicas sharing a base disk, while local state managers and layered recovery replenish pools and contain failures.

key_results.zh: 该架构在受限资源下管理上千副本并提高并行轨迹吞吐，同时大幅减少磁盘占用、配置时间与单副本成本。
key_results.en: The architecture manages over a thousand replicas under constrained resources, raises trajectory throughput, and markedly reduces disk use, provisioning time, and per-replica cost.

limitations.zh: 收益依赖 KVM、写时复制和特定硬件瓶颈；摘要未覆盖异构操作系统镜像、安全隔离强度及长期软件漂移的维护成本。
limitations.en: Benefits depend on KVM, copy-on-write, and particular hardware bottlenecks; heterogeneous images, isolation assurance, and long-term software drift are not established.

workloads: End-to-end computer-use data collection and training

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 字段和数值仅转录自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未披露的表格级条件、硬件与集群配置及更多对照项仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation fields and numbers above are transcribed only from the official arXiv abstract; table-level conditions, hardware and cluster configurations, and additional comparisons not stated there await full-text audit.
